newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bourses, banks closed on Jan 23 holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian bourses, banks closed on Jan 23 holiday.

text.p: All major stock exchanges across India, including the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange, will be closed on January 23 on account of a national holiday, officials said on Tuesday.
They said January 23 has been declared a national holiday to mark the centenary birth anniversary of Subhas Chandra Bose, a well-known Indian freedom fighter.
Commodities traders said Bombay-based bullion, cotton, metals, sugar and castorseed markets were also expected to be closed. -- Bombay newsroom +91-22-265 9000
